name: Patal Lok underground road (Bhosari to Undri)
title: Patal Lok underground road, Bhosari to Undri: status
summary: The Pune Municipal Corporation's planned network of road tunnels under the city ('Patal Lok'), led by a 23 km tunnel from Bhosari to Undri through Kondhwa's Khadi Machine Chowk, with an 8 km Bhugaon-Erandwane tunnel and a Swargate-Shaniwarwada study.
means: This is a plan at the project-report stage, not a road being built. A flat ad that counts on it is selling a plan; check this page for the stage.

faq.q: What is Patal Lok in Pune?
faq.a: The Pune Municipal Corporation's plan for road tunnels under the city. Its first priority is a 23 km tunnel from Bhosari to Undri through Kondhwa's Khadi Machine Chowk.
No. As of November 2026 a consultant was being hired to prepare the detailed project report for the Bhosari-Undri tunnel.

history.status: The Pune Municipal Corporation plans a 31 km network of underground road tunnels connecting Bhosari, Undri, Bhugaon and Erandwane.

Plan reworked: the 23 km Bhosari-Undri tunnel through Khadi Machine Chowk is now the priority, and the civic body approved hiring a consultant for its detailed project report. A project report for an 8 km Bhugaon-Erandwane tunnel was approved, and a Swargate-Shaniwarwada tunnel is being studied.
